seed_variance_observation: Same configuration as B28_lr1e-05_b5200_seed17_retry2 (lr 1e-5, 5200-token budget, cosine, full parameters), differing only in the seed that shuffles training-row order. seed17 reached 73/150 and seed23 reached 58/150 -- a 15-row spread with near-identical dev CE (2.2481 vs 2.2642). The panel cannot certify an effect below 6 discordant rows split 6-0, so run-to-run variance may exceed most effects measured in this programme. Depth-family comparisons all used seed 17 and remain internally matched; absolute headline numbers are seed-specific and n=2.
storage_transport_note: PROVENANCE GAP CLOSED HERE. arm_dose records optimizer_storage_backend from the RAB001_ADAM_STORAGE env value only, and optimizer_storage_harness_sha256 pins the streamed_adam.py source. Neither captures the RAB001_ADAM_DIRECT_IO runtime toggle, which is the single variable this storage_only retry changed. This run was invoked with RAB001_ADAM_STORAGE=streamed and RAB001_ADAM_DIRECT_IO=1, enabling Windows NO_BUFFERING|WRITE_THROUGH transfers so spilled Adam moments bypass the OS data cache.
why_the_previous_attempt_failed: The prior attempt used streamed spill WITHOUT the cache bypass and was stood down by hostbudget at step 1 with 0.77 GiB free and commit 12.6 GiB over physical. This run held at about 3.0-3.4 GiB free and completed all 40 steps.
